name: Pesepay

status.webhook_verification: resultUrl callback is only a 'go poll now' trigger — the body is NOT trusted. Re-verify server-side via GET /v1/payments/check-payment?referenceNumber= and decrypt the { payload } response.

credentials_required.label: Integration Key
credentials_required.note: Sent as an HTTP header on every call. NOTE: SDKs disagree on the header name ('authorization' vs 'key'); the value is the raw key, NOT a Bearer token.

credentials_required.label: Encryption Key
credentials_required.note: Never sent over the wire — it is the AES key. MUST be 16/24/32 chars, and its first 16 chars ARE the IV.

test_credentials.note: Sandbox is documented but no official test MSISDNs were found — obtain them from Pesepay support. Sandbox host is UNVERIFIED; ManishaPay falls back to the live base until confirmed.

sandbox.notes: Use the ManishaPay simulator for local end-to-end testing until Pesepay provides sandbox MSISDNs/cards.

pain_points.problem: All requests/responses fail to decrypt or are rejected outright
pain_points.cause: Wrong AES parameters — devs use a random IV or prepend the IV, instead of using the first 16 chars of the Encryption Key as a fixed IV
pain_points.mitigation: IV = key.subarray(0,16); AES-CBC + PKCS7 + base64; wrap/unwrap the { payload } envelope on BOTH directions. Covered by an encrypt→decrypt round-trip unit test with a fixed vector.

pain_points.cause: Encryption Key copied with trailing spaces or truncated, so it is not 16/24/32 bytes
pain_points.mitigation: Validate the key length up-front (assertKeyLength) and choose the AES variant (128/192/256) from the byte length.

pain_points.problem: 401 Unauthorized even with a correct Integration Key
pain_points.cause: The header NAME differs across community SDKs — some expect 'key:', others 'authorization:'
pain_points.mitigation: Pin the header name in one const (AUTH_HEADER_NAME) so it can be flipped in a single place; send the raw key (not 'Bearer ').

pain_points.problem: Payment method code errors / breakage after Pesepay changes
pain_points.cause: Method codes (PZW201 EcoCash, PZW204 Visa, PZW211 mobile, PZW212 InnBucks) are currency-scoped and change
pain_points.mitigation: Never hardcode codes — resolve them live via GET /v1/payment-methods/for-currency?currencyCode= and match by rail name; cache per currency.

pain_points.problem: Order marked paid when it is not
pain_points.cause: Trusting the resultUrl callback body, or treating PARTIALLY_PAID/liquidationStatus as completion
pain_points.mitigation: Only transactionStatus === 'SUCCESS' is paid; PARTIALLY_PAID stays pending; ignore liquidationStatus (settlement). Re-poll after the callback with a timeout/backoff.

pain_points.cause: Card rail on Pesepay is unreliable in Zimbabwe
pain_points.mitigation: Route card elsewhere; use Pesepay primarily for EcoCash/mobile money.

pain_points.problem: Wrong endpoint version for the flow
pain_points.cause: Redirect uses /v1/payments/initiate but seamless mobile-push uses /v2/payments/make-payment
pain_points.mitigation: Encode the version per flow — redirect => v1, seamless => v2.

notes: Zimbabwean aggregator with faster onboarding than PayNow (registration ~5min, verification ~30-60min). Encryption is the defining integration hazard: AES-256-CBC with a NON-random IV = first 16 chars of the Encryption Key, PKCS7, base64, wrapped as { payload } on request AND response. No public refund or recurring API (portal/manual only). EcoCash is the reliable rail.
